en: Commemorative postcard featuring two oval portraits: on the left a bearded man in a decorated military uniform, on the right a woman in an elegant dress with high lace collar. Above them is a crown and coat of arms, with the dates 1886 and 1911. Below the portraits, surrounded by ornate Art Nouveau framing, is Gothic-style German text. Colorful carnations (red, pink, white, yellow) decorate the bottom. The card marks the silver wedding anniversary of the royal couple of Württemberg on 8 April 1911.
